name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3341: payload_for declared its truncation as a character count, which cannot say WHICH files are missing. Measured by rebuilding it for v3300-v3340: 22 of 36 versions with code changes had at least one changed code file never reach the eye, and in several the dropped file is the version whole subject. The roster now comes from git rather than the fetched text, because a file the payload never asked for is missing from the QUESTION and not from any buffer. Three states: a LIST names what never arrived, empty means measured-and-none, None means the roster was unreadable and stays UNKNOWN.
